Corollary
[Laplacian of a parametrix convolution] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0264 ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch23-second-convolution-derivative 1. ch23:23.28\group Convolution differentiation

In geodesic coordinates centered at $x$, \[ \Delta _x(P_N*G)(x,y,t)=\int _0^t\int _{\mathcal M} \Delta _xP_N(x,z,t-s)G(z,y,s)\, d\mu (z)\, ds. \]
